title: add-transactional-downgrade-guard-backup-restore-schema-migrations-private-installer
description: Motivation: Private installer upgrades for customers running on-prem and VPC have several failure modes during schema migrations and multi-node rollout that make downgrades dangerous. This change adds a transactional downgrade guard coupled with enhanced backup/restore verification to ensure safe rollbacks across versions. Summary: Implement a migration orchestration guard that (1) pins component versions during the upgrade window, (2) runs transactional schema migrations with pre/post-checks, (3) takes consistent backup snapshots (etcd + postgres + object-store manifest) and verifies restoreability in a dry-run mode, and (4) exposes a rollback-safe annotation and CLI flag for the private-installer. Also update Helm charts and Terraform module docs to surface new knobs and default pins. What I changed: Updated private-installer orchestration controller, added migration transaction manager, backup verifier job, helm chart values and templates for version pinning, and terraform module inputs for pinning/rollback-policy. Added unit and e2e tests and expanded upgrade docs. Checklist: - [x] Migration transaction manager implemented - [x] Backup snapshot + deterministic manifest created - [x] Dry-run restore verification job added - [x] Helm values for version_pinning and downgrade_guard added - [x] Terraform inputs + docs updated - [x] e2e test covering upgrade/rollback scenario - [x] Performance regression tests run on canary cluster Notes: This PR is intended to be a no-op for existing installs unless the new helm values are set. The default behaviour remains the same (conservative, no automatic downgrade). For private customers that opt-in, the new guard will prevent a downgrade until the restore verification succeeds. Related Linear: ENG-8942, ENG-9020.
